title: Phaseo · Gateway and providers
description: Request summaries cover received terminal events. Trace retention is sampled. Delivery is best effort, so counts are operational rather than financial.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (rate({service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", outcome="outcome", provider="provider", model="model" | __error__="" | provider=~".*${provider:regex}.*" | model=~".*${model:regex}.*" | environment="$environment" | event_name="gateway.request" [$__auto]))

sum by (provider, outcome) (rate({service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", provider="provider", outcome="outcome", model="model" | __error__="" | provider=~".*${provider:regex}.*" | model=~".*${model:regex}.*" | environment="$environment" | event_name="provider.attempt" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Streaming p95 time to first token
panels.description: Downstream first token timing. Null timings are omitted, never converted into zero.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", ttft_ms="ttft_ms", stream="stream", provider="provider", model="model" | __error__="" | provider=~".*${provider:regex}.*" | model=~".*${model:regex}.*" | environment="$environment" | event_name="gateway.request" | stream="true" | unwrap ttft_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (service_name)

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", provider_ttft_ms="provider_ttft_ms", stream="stream", provider="provider", model="model" | __error__="" | provider=~".*${provider:regex}.*" | model=~".*${model:regex}.*" | environment="$environment" | event_name="gateway.request" | stream="true" | unwrap provider_ttft_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (service_name)

sum(rate({service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", attempt_count="attempt_count", provider="provider", model="model" | __error__="" | provider=~".*${provider:regex}.*" | model=~".*${model:regex}.*" | environment="$environment" | event_name="gateway.request" | attempt_count > 1 | __error__="" [$__auto])) or vector(0)

sum(rate({service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", outcome="outcome", provider="provider", model="model" | __error__="" | provider=~".*${provider:regex}.*" | model=~".*${model:regex}.*" | environment="$environment" | event_name="gateway.request" | outcome="cancelled" | __error__="" [$__auto])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Provider attempt lookup
panels.description: Newest 100 matching provider attempts. A failed attempt can recover through fallback. Attempt detail is capped per request; use Inspect matching logs for the original event.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", request_id="request_id", provider="provider", model="model" | __error__="" | provider=~".*${provider:regex}.*" | model=~".*${model:regex}.*" | environment="$environment" | event_name="provider.attempt" | request_id=~"${request:regex}.*"

panels.title: Provider and model attempts
panels.description: Selected-range received events. Up to 10 failing and 10 busiest groups; sorted by failures. Failure % uses the displayed attempts population. p95 uses available timings; sparse samples are unstable. A dash means unavailable, not zero. Attempt failures can recover through fallback. Model is the provider model slug; stealth attempts are excluded.

panels.title: Gateway failure reasons
panels.description: Logical request failures grouped by classification, including non-actionable client rejections. Cancellations are excluded. Attempt failures can recover through fallback.

targets.expr: label_replace((topk(20, sum by (error_origin, error_kind, error_code, provider, model) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", error_origin="error_origin", error_kind="error_kind", error_code="error_code", provider="provider", model="model", outcome="outcome" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="gateway.request" | provider=~".*${provider:regex}.*" | model=~".*${model:regex}.*" | outcome="error" | __error__="" [$__range])))), "measure", "Events", "", "")
